overview: NextGen IT Hub is a comprehensive all-in-one digital services platform for Manash PC World in Chamata, Assam. It combines an e-commerce store, government document services, job updates, entertainment with Assamese music, AI chatbot, image tools, and tourism showcase — all with an iOS-inspired Pink and Sky gradient design and a full admin panel for managing every section of the site.
features: iOS-style Pink and Sky Blue gradient design with glassmorphism cards
Full e-commerce store with cart, checkout and order tracking
Assamese Music Library with YouTube embed, lyrics, singer/movie/category browse
Government Forms Library with 50+ downloadable PDFs and usage guides
Job Updates with CSC Bridge section and animated stats
Assam Tourism showcase with 10 pre-loaded famous places
Comprehensive admin panel managing all site content permanently
AI Chatbot (Manash 2.0) powered by Groq with streaming responses
Document converter and 8-tool image processing suite
PWA installable as NextGen IT Hub with offline support
